datasets.name: ov_lgu
queryLines:
SELECT b.*, st_setsrid(st_simplify(st_geomfromgeojson(h.geometry), 0.003), 4326) AS boundary
FROM (
WITH lgu AS (
  SELECT d.city_mun_psgc_code, d.city_mun_name,
         d.city_mun_name || ', ' || COALESCE(d.province_name, d.region_name) AS lgu_label,
         COALESCE(d.province_name, 'Independent cities (no province)') AS province_label,
         d.region_name,
         CASE d.lgu_type WHEN 'city' THEN 'City' WHEN 'municipality' THEN 'Municipality' END AS lgu_type_label,
         CASE d.lgu_type WHEN 'city' THEN 'cities' ELSE 'municipalities' END AS type_plural
  FROM edu_access.`05-gold`.dim_city_municipality AS d
  WHERE d.member_type = 'regular'
),
pri AS (
  SELECT l.lgu_label, l.province_label, l.lgu_type_label, l.type_plural, p.*,
         COALESCE(NULLIF(concat_ws(' + ', CASE WHEN p.ap1_status = 'high' THEN 'Schools' END,
                                          CASE WHEN p.ap2_status = 'high' THEN 'Rooms' END,
                                          CASE WHEN p.ap3_status = 'high' THEN 'Teachers' END), ''), 'None high') AS combo,
         COALESCE(NULLIF(p.high_measures, ''), 'None high') AS high_measures_view,
         CASE p.ap3_highest_level WHEN 'ES' THEN p.ap3_es_coverage_pct WHEN 'JHS' THEN p.ap3_jhs_coverage_pct
              WHEN 'SHS' THEN p.ap3_shs_coverage_pct END AS ap3_coverage_pct,
         CASE p.ap3_highest_level WHEN 'ES' THEN p.ap3_es_learners_per_teacher WHEN 'JHS' THEN p.ap3_jhs_learners_per_teacher
              WHEN 'SHS' THEN p.ap3_shs_learners_per_teacher END AS ap3_value,
         CASE WHEN p.tier_code = 'data_review'
              THEN 'Not assessed: ' || concat_ws(', ', CASE WHEN p.ap1_status = 'not_assessed' THEN 'schools' END,
                                                       CASE WHEN p.ap2_status = 'not_assessed' THEN 'rooms' END,
                                                       CASE WHEN p.ap3_status = 'not_assessed' THEN 'teachers' END)
              ELSE '' END AS data_review_reason,
         CASE WHEN p.is_stable THEN 'Stable' ELSE '' END AS stability,
         CASE WHEN p.outlier_schools > 0
              THEN CAST(p.outlier_schools AS STRING) || ' outlier schools; tier '
                   || CASE WHEN p.tier_code_without_outliers = p.tier_code THEN 'holds' ELSE 'changes' END || ' without them'
              ELSE '' END AS outlier_note
  FROM edu_access.`06-analytics`.lgu_priority AS p
  JOIN lgu AS l ON l.city_mun_psgc_code = p.city_mun_psgc_code
)
SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY priority_rank) AS rank_in_view, priority_rank,
       city_mun_psgc_code, lgu_label, lgu_type_label, province_label, region_name,
       tier_label, tier_sort, CASE WHEN tier_sort > 0 THEN tier_sort END AS tier_level,
       combo, high_measures_view, data_review_reason, stability, outlier_note, affected_learners,
       100.0 * ap1_percentile AS ap1_pct, ap1_relative_pressure AS ap1_rp, ap1_coverage_pct AS ap1_cov,
       100.0 * ap2_percentile AS ap2_pct, ap2_relative_pressure AS ap2_rp, ap2_coverage_pct AS ap2_cov,
       100.0 * ap3_percentile AS ap3_pct, ap3_relative_pressure AS ap3_rp, ap3_coverage_pct AS ap3_cov,
       ap3_highest_level
FROM pri
WHERE (:region = 'All regions' OR region_name = :region) AND (:province = 'All provinces' OR province_label = :province) AND (:lgu_type = 'All LGU types' OR lgu_type_label = :lgu_type) AND (:tier = 'All tiers' OR tier_label = :tier) AND (:combo = 'All combinations' OR combo = :combo) AND (:cov = 'All LGUs' OR (:cov = 'Assessed' AND tier_code <> 'data_review') OR (:cov = 'Data review' AND tier_code = 'data_review'))
) AS b
LEFT JOIN edu_access.`04-integration`.hdx_adm3_psgc_map AS m
  ON m.psgc_code = b.city_mun_psgc_code AND m.match_status = 'matched'
LEFT JOIN edu_access.`03-silver`.hdx_adm3_clean AS h ON h.adm3_pcode = m.adm3_pcode
ORDER BY b.priority_rank

  FROM edu_access.`05-gold`.dim_city_municipality AS d
  WHERE d.member_type = 'regular'
),
a AS (
  SELECT g.* FROM edu_access.`06-analytics`.ap4_population_enrollment_gap AS g
  JOIN lgu AS l ON l.city_mun_psgc_code = g.city_mun_psgc_code
  WHERE g.population_enrollment_gap IS NOT NULL AND (:region = 'All regions' OR l.region_name = :region) AND (:province = 'All provinces' OR l.province_label = :province) AND (:lgu_type = 'All LGU types' OR l.lgu_type_label = :lgu_type)
),
both_years AS (SELECT city_mun_psgc_code FROM a GROUP BY city_mun_psgc_code HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT reference_year) = 2),
b AS (
  SELECT CASE a.reference_year WHEN 2020 THEN '2020 · SY 2020-21' ELSE '2024 · SY 2024-25' END AS period, a.*
  FROM a JOIN both_years USING (city_mun_psgc_code)
)
SELECT period, 'Children aged 5-17' AS series, SUM(school_age_population) AS people FROM b GROUP BY period
UNION ALL SELECT period, 'Enrollment, all sectors', SUM(enrollment_all_sectors) FROM b GROUP BY period
UNION ALL SELECT period, 'Gap (children minus enrollment)', SUM(population_enrollment_gap) FROM b GROUP BY period

  LIMIT 1

lv AS (
  SELECT t.*, l.lgu_type, l.type_plural FROM edu_access.`06-analytics`.ap3_teacher_pressure AS t
  JOIN (SELECT city_mun_psgc_code, CASE lgu_type_label WHEN 'City' THEN 'city' ELSE 'municipality' END AS lgu_type, type_plural FROM lgu) AS l
    ON l.city_mun_psgc_code = t.city_mun_psgc_code
  WHERE t.school_year = '2023-24'
),
base AS (
  SELECT lgu_type, education_level_code,
         SUM(learners_in_ratio) / NULLIF(CAST(SUM(teachers_in_ratio) AS DOUBLE), 0) AS baseline
  FROM lv
  WHERE schools_in_scope > 0 AND learners_per_teacher IS NOT NULL AND learner_coverage_pct >= 90
  GROUP BY lgu_type, education_level_code
),
me AS (
  SELECT lv.*, p.ap3_highest_level, b.baseline,
         CASE lv.education_level_code WHEN 'ES' THEN 'Elementary (ES)' WHEN 'JHS' THEN 'Junior high (JHS)' WHEN 'SHS' THEN 'Senior high (SHS)' END
           || CASE WHEN lv.education_level_code = p.ap3_highest_level THEN ' · sets AP3'
                   WHEN lv.schools_in_scope = 0 THEN ' · not offered'
                   WHEN lv.learner_coverage_pct IS NULL OR lv.learner_coverage_pct < 90 THEN ' · not assessed' ELSE '' END AS level_label

  JOIN edu_access.`06-analytics`.lgu_priority AS p ON p.city_mun_psgc_code = lv.city_mun_psgc_code
  LEFT JOIN base AS b ON b.lgu_type = lv.lgu_type AND b.education_level_code = lv.education_level_code

datasets.name: pr_brgy
queryLines:
WITH lgu AS (
  SELECT d.city_mun_psgc_code, d.city_mun_name,
         d.city_mun_name || ', ' || COALESCE(d.province_name, d.region_name) AS lgu_label,
         COALESCE(d.province_name, 'Independent cities (no province)') AS province_label,
         d.region_name,
         CASE d.lgu_type WHEN 'city' THEN 'City' WHEN 'municipality' THEN 'Municipality' END AS lgu_type_label,
         CASE d.lgu_type WHEN 'city' THEN 'cities' ELSE 'municipalities' END AS type_plural
  FROM edu_access.`05-gold`.dim_city_municipality AS d
  WHERE d.member_type = 'regular'
),
sel AS (
  SELECT l.city_mun_psgc_code, l.lgu_label
  FROM lgu AS l
  JOIN edu_access.`06-analytics`.lgu_priority AS p ON p.city_mun_psgc_code = l.city_mun_psgc_code
  WHERE (:region = 'All regions' OR l.region_name = :region) AND (:province = 'All provinces' OR l.province_label = :province) AND (:lgu_type = 'All LGU types' OR l.lgu_type_label = :lgu_type)
  ORDER BY CASE WHEN l.lgu_label = :lgu THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, p.priority_rank
  LIMIT 1
),
lvl AS (SELECT 'ES' AS level_code),
s AS (
  SELECT e.school_id, MAX(e.barangay_psgc_code) AS barangay_psgc_code, MAX(e.annex_status) AS annex_status,
         MAX(CASE WHEN e.education_level_code = 'ES' AND e.is_offered THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS offers_es,
         MAX(CASE WHEN e.education_level_code = 'JHS' AND e.is_offered THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS offers_jhs,
         MAX(CASE WHEN e.education_level_code = 'SHS' AND e.is_offered THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS offers_shs,
         MAX(CASE WHEN e.education_level_code = (SELECT level_code FROM lvl) AND e.is_offered THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS offers_level,
         SUM(CASE WHEN e.is_offered THEN e.learner_count END) AS learners,
         SUM(CASE WHEN e.is_offered AND e.education_level_code = (SELECT level_code FROM lvl) THEN e.learner_count END) AS level_learners
  FROM edu_access.`05-gold`.fact_school_enrollment AS e
  JOIN sel ON sel.city_mun_psgc_code = e.city_mun_psgc_code
  WHERE e.sector = 'Public' AND e.school_year = '2023-24'
  GROUP BY e.school_id
),
t AS (
  SELECT school_id, SUM(teacher_count) AS teachers,
         MAX(CASE WHEN education_level_code = 'ES' THEN COALESCE(teacher_count, -1) END) AS es_t,
         MAX(CASE WHEN education_level_code = 'JHS' THEN COALESCE(teacher_count, -1) END) AS jhs_t,
         MAX(CASE WHEN education_level_code = 'SHS' THEN COALESCE(teacher_count, -1) END) AS shs_t,
         SUM(CASE WHEN education_level_code = (SELECT level_code FROM lvl) THEN teacher_count END) AS level_teachers
  FROM edu_access.`05-gold`.fact_school_teacher_capacity WHERE school_year = '2023-24' GROUP BY school_id
),
o AS (
  SELECT school_id,
         MAX(CASE WHEN measure = 'AP2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS room_outlier,
         MAX(CASE WHEN measure = 'AP3' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS teacher_outlier_any,
         MAX(CASE WHEN measure = 'AP3' AND education_level_code = (SELECT level_code FROM lvl) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS teacher_outlier,
         MAX(ratio / NULLIF(upper_fence, 0)) AS times_fence
  FROM edu_access.`06-analytics`.lgu_priority_outlier_schools GROUP BY school_id
),
x AS (
  SELECT s.school_id, COALESCE(ds.school_name, s.school_id) AS school_name,
         COALESCE(b.barangay_name, 'Barangay not matched') AS barangay_name,
         CASE WHEN s.annex_status = 'Annex/Extension School' THEN 'Annex' ELSE 'Main' END AS school_kind,
         concat_ws(' + ', CASE WHEN s.offers_es = 1 THEN 'ES' END, CASE WHEN s.offers_jhs = 1 THEN 'JHS' END,
                          CASE WHEN s.offers_shs = 1 THEN 'SHS' END) AS levels_offered,
         (SELECT level_code FROM lvl) AS level_code, s.offers_level,
         s.learners, s.level_learners, r.instructional_classrooms_total AS rooms, t.teachers, t.level_teachers,
         COALESCE(r.temporary_learning_spaces, 0) + COALESCE(r.makeshift_rooms, 0) AS tls_and_makeshift_rooms,
         s.learners / NULLIF(CAST(r.instructional_classrooms_total AS DOUBLE), 0) AS learners_per_room,
         s.level_learners / NULLIF(CAST(t.level_teachers AS DOUBLE), 0) AS learners_per_teacher_level,
         COALESCE(o.room_outlier, 0) AS room_outlier, COALESCE(o.teacher_outlier, 0) AS teacher_outlier,
         COALESCE(o.teacher_outlier_any, 0) AS teacher_outlier_any, o.times_fence,
         CASE WHEN r.instructional_classrooms_total IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS rooms_missing,
         CASE WHEN r.instructional_classrooms_total = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS rooms_zero,
         CASE WHEN (s.offers_es = 1 AND COALESCE(t.es_t, -1) = -1) OR (s.offers_jhs = 1 AND COALESCE(t.jhs_t, -1) = -1)
                OR (s.offers_shs = 1 AND COALESCE(t.shs_t, -1) = -1) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS teachers_missing,
         CASE WHEN (s.offers_es = 1 AND t.es_t = 0) OR (s.offers_jhs = 1 AND t.jhs_t = 0)
                OR (s.offers_shs = 1 AND t.shs_t = 0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS teachers_zero
  FROM s
  LEFT JOIN edu_access.`05-gold`.dim_school AS ds ON ds.school_id = s.school_id
  LEFT JOIN edu_access.`05-gold`.dim_barangay AS b ON b.barangay_psgc_code = s.barangay_psgc_code
  LEFT JOIN edu_access.`05-gold`.fact_school_classroom_capacity AS r ON r.school_id = s.school_id AND r.school_year = '2023-24'
  LEFT JOIN t ON t.school_id = s.school_id
  LEFT JOIN o ON o.school_id = s.school_id
  WHERE s.learners > 0
),
flagged AS (
  SELECT x.*,
         CASE WHEN room_outlier = 1 OR teacher_outlier_any = 1 THEN 'Outlier: check the report'
              WHEN rooms_missing = 1 OR teachers_missing = 1 THEN 'Missing data'
              WHEN rooms_zero = 1 OR teachers_zero = 1 THEN 'Zero rooms or teachers'
              ELSE 'No flag' END AS flag,
         concat_ws(', ', CASE WHEN room_outlier = 1 THEN 'room outlier' END,
                         CASE WHEN teacher_outlier_any = 1 THEN 'teacher outlier' END,
                         CASE WHEN rooms_missing = 1 THEN 'rooms not reported' END,
                         CASE WHEN rooms_zero = 1 THEN 'zero rooms' END,
                         CASE WHEN teachers_missing = 1 THEN 'a level with no teacher row' END,
                         CASE WHEN teachers_zero = 1 THEN 'a level with zero teachers' END) AS issues
  FROM x
),
bs AS (
  SELECT x.barangay_name, COUNT(*) AS schools, MAX(CASE WHEN x.levels_offered LIKE '%ES%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS offers_es,
         SUM(x.learners) AS learners, SUM(x.rooms) AS rooms, SUM(x.teachers) AS teachers
  FROM flagged AS x GROUP BY x.barangay_name
),
br AS (
  SELECT b.barangay_name, COALESCE(b.urban_rural, 'n/a') AS urban_rural,
         COALESCE(bs.schools, 0) AS schools, CASE WHEN COALESCE(bs.offers_es, 0) = 1 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS offers_public_es,
         COALESCE(bs.learners, 0) AS learners, COALESCE(bs.rooms, 0) AS rooms, COALESCE(bs.teachers, 0) AS teachers
  FROM edu_access.`05-gold`.dim_barangay AS b
  JOIN sel ON sel.city_mun_psgc_code = b.city_mun_psgc_code
  LEFT JOIN bs ON bs.barangay_name = b.barangay_name
  WHERE b.member_type = 'regular'
)
SELECT br.*, br.barangay_name || CASE WHEN br.offers_public_es = 'No' THEN ' · no public ES' ELSE '' END AS barangay_label,
       ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY CASE WHEN br.offers_public_es = 'No' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, br.learners DESC, br.barangay_name) AS brgy_order
FROM br
ORDER BY brgy_order

),

s AS (
  SELECT e.school_id, MAX(e.barangay_psgc_code) AS barangay_psgc_code, MAX(e.annex_status) AS annex_status,
         MAX(CASE WHEN e.education_level_code = 'ES' AND e.is_offered THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS offers_es,
         MAX(CASE WHEN e.education_level_code = 'JHS' AND e.is_offered THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS offers_jhs,
         MAX(CASE WHEN e.education_level_code = 'SHS' AND e.is_offered THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS offers_shs,
         MAX(CASE WHEN e.education_level_code = (SELECT level_code FROM lvl) AND e.is_offered THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS offers_level,
         SUM(CASE WHEN e.is_offered THEN e.learner_count END) AS learners,
         SUM(CASE WHEN e.is_offered AND e.education_level_code = (SELECT level_code FROM lvl) THEN e.learner_count END) AS level_learners
  FROM edu_access.`05-gold`.fact_school_enrollment AS e
  JOIN sel ON sel.city_mun_psgc_code = e.city_mun_psgc_code
  WHERE e.sector = 'Public' AND e.school_year = '2023-24'
  GROUP BY e.school_id
),
t AS (
  SELECT school_id, SUM(teacher_count) AS teachers,
         MAX(CASE WHEN education_level_code = 'ES' THEN COALESCE(teacher_count, -1) END) AS es_t,
         MAX(CASE WHEN education_level_code = 'JHS' THEN COALESCE(teacher_count, -1) END) AS jhs_t,
         MAX(CASE WHEN education_level_code = 'SHS' THEN COALESCE(teacher_count, -1) END) AS shs_t,
         SUM(CASE WHEN education_level_code = (SELECT level_code FROM lvl) THEN teacher_count END) AS level_teachers
  FROM edu_access.`05-gold`.fact_school_teacher_capacity WHERE school_year = '2023-24' GROUP BY school_id
),
o AS (
  SELECT school_id,
         MAX(CASE WHEN measure = 'AP2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS room_outlier,
         MAX(CASE WHEN measure = 'AP3' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS teacher_outlier_any,
         MAX(CASE WHEN measure = 'AP3' AND education_level_code = (SELECT level_code FROM lvl) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS teacher_outlier,
         MAX(ratio / NULLIF(upper_fence, 0)) AS times_fence
  FROM edu_access.`06-analytics`.lgu_priority_outlier_schools GROUP BY school_id
),
x AS (
  SELECT s.school_id, COALESCE(ds.school_name, s.school_id) AS school_name,
         COALESCE(b.barangay_name, 'Barangay not matched') AS barangay_name,
         CASE WHEN s.annex_status = 'Annex/Extension School' THEN 'Annex' ELSE 'Main' END AS school_kind,
         concat_ws(' + ', CASE WHEN s.offers_es = 1 THEN 'ES' END, CASE WHEN s.offers_jhs = 1 THEN 'JHS' END,
                          CASE WHEN s.offers_shs = 1 THEN 'SHS' END) AS levels_offered,
         (SELECT level_code FROM lvl) AS level_code, s.offers_level,
         s.learners, s.level_learners, r.instructional_classrooms_total AS rooms, t.teachers, t.level_teachers,
         COALESCE(r.temporary_learning_spaces, 0) + COALESCE(r.makeshift_rooms, 0) AS tls_and_makeshift_rooms,
         s.learners / NULLIF(CAST(r.instructional_classrooms_total AS DOUBLE), 0) AS learners_per_room,
         s.level_learners / NULLIF(CAST(t.level_teachers AS DOUBLE), 0) AS learners_per_teacher_level,
         COALESCE(o.room_outlier, 0) AS room_outlier, COALESCE(o.teacher_outlier, 0) AS teacher_outlier,
         COALESCE(o.teacher_outlier_any, 0) AS teacher_outlier_any, o.times_fence,
         CASE WHEN r.instructional_classrooms_total IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS rooms_missing,
         CASE WHEN r.instructional_classrooms_total = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS rooms_zero,
         CASE WHEN (s.offers_es = 1 AND COALESCE(t.es_t, -1) = -1) OR (s.offers_jhs = 1 AND COALESCE(t.jhs_t, -1) = -1)
                OR (s.offers_shs = 1 AND COALESCE(t.shs_t, -1) = -1) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS teachers_missing,
         CASE WHEN (s.offers_es = 1 AND t.es_t = 0) OR (s.offers_jhs = 1 AND t.jhs_t = 0)
                OR (s.offers_shs = 1 AND t.shs_t = 0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS teachers_zero
  FROM s
  LEFT JOIN edu_access.`05-gold`.dim_school AS ds ON ds.school_id = s.school_id
  LEFT JOIN edu_access.`05-gold`.dim_barangay AS b ON b.barangay_psgc_code = s.barangay_psgc_code
  LEFT JOIN edu_access.`05-gold`.fact_school_classroom_capacity AS r ON r.school_id = s.school_id AND r.school_year = '2023-24'
  LEFT JOIN t ON t.school_id = s.school_id
  LEFT JOIN o ON o.school_id = s.school_id
  WHERE s.learners > 0
),
flagged AS (
  SELECT x.*,
         CASE WHEN room_outlier = 1 OR teacher_outlier_any = 1 THEN 'Outlier: check the report'
              WHEN rooms_missing = 1 OR teachers_missing = 1 THEN 'Missing data'
              WHEN rooms_zero = 1 OR teachers_zero = 1 THEN 'Zero rooms or teachers'
              ELSE 'No flag' END AS flag,
         concat_ws(', ', CASE WHEN room_outlier = 1 THEN 'room outlier' END,
                         CASE WHEN teacher_outlier_any = 1 THEN 'teacher outlier' END,
                         CASE WHEN rooms_missing = 1 THEN 'rooms not reported' END,
                         CASE WHEN rooms_zero = 1 THEN 'zero rooms' END,
                         CASE WHEN teachers_missing = 1 THEN 'a level with no teacher row' END,
                         CASE WHEN teachers_zero = 1 THEN 'a level with zero teachers' END) AS issues
  FROM x
)
SELECT COUNT_IF(flag <> 'No flag') AS schools_to_check, COUNT(*) AS schools FROM flagged

         COALESCE(NULLIF(concat_ws(' + ', CASE WHEN p.ap1_status = 'high' THEN 'Schools' END,
                                          CASE WHEN p.ap2_status = 'high' THEN 'Rooms' END,
                                          CASE WHEN p.ap3_status = 'high' THEN 'Teachers' END), ''), 'None high') AS combo,

         CASE p.ap3_highest_level WHEN 'ES' THEN p.ap3_es_coverage_pct WHEN 'JHS' THEN p.ap3_jhs_coverage_pct
              WHEN 'SHS' THEN p.ap3_shs_coverage_pct END AS ap3_coverage_pct,
         CASE p.ap3_highest_level WHEN 'ES' THEN p.ap3_es_learners_per_teacher WHEN 'JHS' THEN p.ap3_jhs_learners_per_teacher
              WHEN 'SHS' THEN p.ap3_shs_learners_per_teacher END AS ap3_value,
         CASE WHEN p.tier_code = 'data_review'
              THEN 'Not assessed: ' || concat_ws(', ', CASE WHEN p.ap1_status = 'not_assessed' THEN 'schools' END,
                                                       CASE WHEN p.ap2_status = 'not_assessed' THEN 'rooms' END,
                                                       CASE WHEN p.ap3_status = 'not_assessed' THEN 'teachers' END)
              ELSE '' END AS data_review_reason,
         CASE WHEN p.is_stable THEN 'Stable' ELSE '' END AS stability,
         CASE WHEN p.outlier_schools > 0
              THEN CAST(p.outlier_schools AS STRING) || ' outlier schools; tier '
                   || CASE WHEN p.tier_code_without_outliers = p.tier_code THEN 'holds' ELSE 'changes' END || ' without them'
              ELSE '' END AS outlier_note
  FROM edu_access.`06-analytics`.lgu_priority AS p
  JOIN lgu AS l ON l.city_mun_psgc_code = p.city_mun_psgc_code
),
p AS (SELECT * FROM pri WHERE (:lgu_type = 'All LGU types' OR lgu_type_label = :lgu_type)),
c AS (
  SELECT 1 AS s, 'Main rule' AS check_base, tier_code = '3' AS is_critical, tier_code FROM p
  UNION ALL SELECT 2, 'Ranked nationally', national_tier_code = '3', tier_code FROM p
  UNION ALL SELECT 3, 'Without outlier schools', tier_code_without_outliers = '3', tier_code FROM p
  UNION ALL SELECT 4, '95% coverage gate', critical_at_gate_95, tier_code FROM p
  UNION ALL SELECT 5, 'Line at 85th', critical_at_line_085, tier_code FROM p
  UNION ALL SELECT 6, 'Line at 80th', critical_at_line_080, tier_code FROM p
),
k AS (
  SELECT s, check_base, SUM(CASE WHEN is_critical THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS critical,
         SUM(CASE WHEN is_critical AND tier_code = '3' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS kept
  FROM c GROUP BY s, check_base
),
m AS (SELECT critical AS main_critical FROM k WHERE s = 1)
SELECT CAST(k.s AS STRING) || ' ' || k.check_base || ' · ' || CAST(CAST(ROUND(100.0 * k.kept / NULLIF(m.main_critical, 0)) AS INT) AS STRING) || '% kept' AS check_name,
       'Critical under this check' AS series, k.critical AS lgus FROM k CROSS JOIN m

              THEN 'Not assessed: ' || concat_ws(', ', CASE WHEN p.ap1_status = 'not_assessed' THEN 'schools' END,
                                                       CASE WHEN p.ap2_status = 'not_assessed' THEN 'rooms' END,
                                                       CASE WHEN p.ap3_status = 'not_assessed' THEN 'teachers' END)
              ELSE '' END AS data_review_reason,
         CASE WHEN p.is_stable THEN 'Stable' ELSE '' END AS stability,
         CASE WHEN p.outlier_schools > 0
              THEN CAST(p.outlier_schools AS STRING) || ' outlier schools; tier '
                   || CASE WHEN p.tier_code_without_outliers = p.tier_code THEN 'holds' ELSE 'changes' END || ' without them'
              ELSE '' END AS outlier_note
  FROM edu_access.`06-analytics`.lgu_priority AS p
  JOIN lgu AS l ON l.city_mun_psgc_code = p.city_mun_psgc_code
),
p AS (SELECT * FROM pri WHERE (:lgu_type = 'All LGU types' OR lgu_type_label = :lgu_type)),

  UNION ALL SELECT lgu_type_label, 'Rooms and teachers', ap2_percentile, ap3_percentile, ap2_status, ap3_status FROM p
)

       COUNT(*) AS lgus_compared
FROM pairs
WHERE sa <> 'not_assessed' AND sb <> 'not_assessed'
GROUP BY pair, lgu_type_label
